reviews.title: Western Digital Proven Performer.
reviews.comment: The M2.2 SSDs arrived in perfect shape, within the stated delivery time. They were easy to set up and are blazingly fast.
reviews.author: Philbert

reviews.title: Easy install. 5 minutes tops.
reviews.comment: It doesn’t get any easier than this. 5 minutes to install in the PS5.  When you reconnect power and login, it tells you to format, so click ok.  That’s it. All you have to do is go to settings and tell the PS you want games stored there. 100% recommend.
reviews.author: S P
